title: Fit and pin a hinged collar around a captive shaft
instruction: Open the hinged collar, fit it around the shaft between its fixed end stops, close both halves with the shaft rib in the upper groove, and insert the orange-headed key through all three aligned lugs. Leave the collar retained with both hands clear.
context: Service collars around shafts with fixed end flanges require split access: both halves must be supported, registered around the shaft, and retained by a loose transverse key before the hands withdraw.
setup: Bimanual YAM station; tabletop z=0.7475 m. Metres/kg/radians; x forward, y left, z up; XYZW quaternions. Fixed layout, seed0, object_jitter0. Collision envelopes below are body-local axis-aligned unions; all component shapes and offsets are in scene.json. captive_shaft: steel rigid surrogate, mass1.2kg, envelope(0.052, 0.25, 0.101)m, origin(0.33, 0, 0.8225)m, XYZW(0, 0, 0, 1). lower_collar: aluminium rigid surrogate, mass0.12kg, envelope(0.119, 0.131, 0.03806497)m, origin(0.185, 0, 0.7717)m, XYZW(0, 0, 0, 1). upper_collar: aluminium rigid surrogate, mass0.1kg, envelope(0.10406497, 0.119, 0.051)m, origin(0.185, 0, 0.7717)m, XYZW(0, 0, 0, 1). collar_key: steel rigid surrogate, mass0.025kg, envelope(0.022, 0.093, 0.022)m, origin(0.36, -0.24, 0.7587)m, XYZW(0, 0, 0, 1). Lower handle centre(-0.05,0.09,-0.01)m, upper handle centre(0.07,-0.09,0.025)m in their body frames. Shaft locating rib is2.4mm wide,180mm long and4mm tall. Steel/aluminium are intended physical surrogates; masses and friction are prescribed approximations, not material-calibrated measurements.
scoring: 0.25 for lower_half_located; 0.25 for collar_closed; 0.5 for collar_retained. Each goal requires all numeric predicates in SCORING.md and scene.json. Credit is recomputed, so dislodged components lose credit. Full score also requires all bodies <=0.01 m/s and <=0.2 rad/s, robot clearance >=0.02 m, continuously for 2.0 s; otherwise score is capped at 0.95. Invalid frames, lost parts, fixture motion, broken preservation constraints, joint-limit violations or penetration >0.002 m permanently score zero. Lower-collar placement uses radial distance from the shaft Y axis at most1.5mm and independent axial offset at most1.5mm.
run_limit: 6000 control actions at 20 Hz (300 simulated seconds maximum)
reset_notes: Native reset restores the authored layout and zero joint coordinates, settles through the official adapter, clears scorer history, and records a new episode. Native probes compare two reset repetitions within 3 mm. Seed 0; object_jitter=0.
fidelity: Rigid faceted half-rings and a passive hinge approximate a service collar. Fixed end flanges block axial assembly; a free square key passes through three interleaved lugs. Steel/aluminium material assignments are rigid surrogates with prescribed masses and uncalibrated friction. Extended handles suit YAM jaws. Tests cover rib registration and keyed opening retention, without certified clamping or shaft-torque transfer. PhysX uses480Hz,64/16 solver iterations.
